scope: Full native adjacency qualified for fixed existing candidate pin access; not full design rerouting or native implementation legality
design_binding: Parent manifests bind the original DCP footprint, native node/PIP maps, raw CSR, admission policy, access analysis and SDK runtime. The architecture fingerprint alone does not bind the design.
container: FPGAACCP 64-byte header, schema 0.1, little-endian, payload CRC64/ECMA-182 and architecture fingerprint as in native_csr_schema_v1.json

identity.nodes: Original full-device electrical node IDs; isolated/blocked nodes remain in the index space
identity.nets: Original DCP footprint net IDs; 0xffffffff means no exclusive net
identity.edges: (native PIP catalog ID << 1) | direction, in the full device namespace; parallel PIPs retain distinct keys
identity.native_tile: Use raw nodes.bin column 3 (SDK representative tile), not column 1 (canonical member tile), for tile-class admission

core_nodes.bin.record: boolean: native tile type INT, LAG_LAG or LAGUNA_TILE

private_owner.bin.record: net ID for a noncore original candidate node, otherwise 0xffffffff

access_arcs.bin.coverage: Every and only original directed candidate PIP touching a noncore node

access_objects.nonterminal_components.csv: Must contain no component rows before search qualification; nonterminal noncore transit requires a separate model

arcs.bin.ordering: Exact retained subsequence of each raw source slice, sorted by destination then key

hard_admission.inherited: Preserve all node/PIP protection and candidate terminal ownership from native_policy_schema_v1.json
hard_admission.node_bit_64: Unowned core NODE_PINFEED that is not a Laguna input
hard_admission.exclusive_net: Candidate pin owners plus net-private original noncore nodes plus original core-to-noncore sink boundary nodes; conflicts reject conversion
hard_admission.arcs: Both endpoint masks and native pip_protection[PIP_key >> 1] must be zero; endpoints cannot have different exclusive owners; retain core-core arcs or exact original noncore access arcs only
hard_admission.runtime_requirement: CSR membership alone does not authorize a particular net. A search/commit consumer must enforce exclusive_net against the current net, including seeds and rip-up; full-device consumption is still pending.

laguna_topology.SDK_reference: For every Utils.getLagunaTileTypes() tile and every UBUMP-prefixed wire, take its native node, then two getAllUphillNodes() steps. Record second-step nodes on Utils.isInterConnect tiles and require NODE_PINFEED.
laguna_topology.C++_construction: Mark predecessors of native NODE_LAGUNA_DATA nodes, then INT NODE_PINFEED predecessors of those marked nodes. Do not require the UBUMP root to have multiple SLR memberships.
laguna_topology.independent_check: SDK exports sorted native (tile address, wire index) pairs for input nodes and UBUMP roots. Independent C++ verifier proves the complete NODE_LAGUNA_DATA root set and Laguna input table equal these SDK sets.
laguna_topology.SDK_files: inputs.bin and ubump_nodes.bin: raw little-endian pairs of u32, no FPGAACCP header; hashes and SDK/runtime provenance in SDK run manifest
laguna_topology.crossing_warning: Single-SLR device-edge UBUMPs are part of SDK topology; they are not additional cross-SLR resources. Crossing counts must use full node membership.

validation: Independent full verifier reconstructs private and projected owners from original pins/PIPs, not builder access records
Every raw arc is checked against independent admission; filtered offsets and exact ordered arc sequence must agree
All original candidate PIPs remain in their original direction and are permitted to their original net
Corruption fixtures repair payload CRC so semantic checks, not merely checksums, must reject them
limitations: Original site/pin access choices are fixed; no alternate output selection, LUT-input swapping or new intra-site routing
Preserving original PIPs does not establish legality or reachability of arbitrary new routes
No physical delay, capacity or artificial unit cost is supplied
No complete commercial workload routed, DCP writeback, timing/QoR comparison or hardware result
This native CSR is not the existing host PR packing or HLS kernel ABI; storage size is not HBM feasibility evidence
